create_covariance_estimate_lw: create a Ledoit-Wolf covariance estimate from Gaussian distributed data using sklearn.covariance.LedoitWolf
create_covariance_estimate_oas: create an OAS covariance estimate from Gaussian distributed data using sklearn.covariance.OAS
compare_covariance_estimators: compare Ledoit-Wolf and OAS covariance estimators by measuring MSE error norm across sample sizes
plot_shrinkage_coefficients: plot shrinkage coefficients for Ledoit-Wolf and OAS estimators across a range of sample sizes
